text_block_list.text:
At the Yukoma Hot Spring Resort, the 
international summit gathering racing 
professionals from all around the world is 
finally being held.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Welcome to the Yukoma Hot Springs Resort. 
We have been expecting you.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
So you're our guide. We'll be in your care 
during the summit.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"This will be the room you'll be staying 
in."

text_block_list.name: Foreign Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"My, what a lovely room! —Oh, could these 
arranged flowers be...?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's mimosa. I heard you were coming 
from the south of France, so I prepared 
some.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Umamusume
Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Here is a map of the Yukoma Hot Spring 
Village. Please feel free to take one with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"This map... has little notes here and 
there. 'A friend to those sensitive to 
cold. Gently warms you up and clears away 
swelling. What am I?' ...Hmm?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's a quiz related to that famous 
landmark. If you'd like, why not head over 
there in person and find out the answer?

text_block_list.name: Foreign Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
My, what an interesting touch. Just like 
the flowers in the guest rooms, is this a 
service you came up with?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No. It wasn't just me; someone very dear 
to me helped out too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
They told me: "You love games, you're 
friendly, and you always brighten up my 
mood."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I figured that precisely because of who I 
am, there must be a way of hosting that 
only I can provide.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So, I came up with hospitality that would 
bring peace in the room and excitement 
when stepping outside.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If everyone feels that way during our 
stay, nothing could make me happier!

Afterward, the international summit that 
spanned several days concluded without a 
hitch. And then—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! From the Prez! She's praising 
my hospitality!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Hearing the participants say they had a 
wonderful time makes me beam with pride as 
well"... it says!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right. The landlady and the 
others told me I should take it easy and 
rest today.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It'd be boring all by myself. Why don't 
you stay over too? I already got 
permission from the proprietress.
choice_data_list: Is that so? Then, if you insist...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! I win the target shooting game~♪ 
You still have a long way to go, 
Trainer-kun~
choice_data_list: I'm really no match for you in games.

I'm really no match for you when it comes 
to games, huh.

text_block_list.text:
The night we stayed at Yukoma Ryokan. We 
were taking a leisurely stroll through the 
hot spring town. During our walk――

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. It's almost time for the 
Arima Kinen, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely win. In order to surpass 
the Prez!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Still, a thought just crossed my mind. 
What would happen if I actually beat the 
one I look up to?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I think about it... it's like, 
there's this big, gaping hole in my 
chest...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Still... through entertaining everyone 
this time, I realized something!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The visitors from overseas seemed to have 
so much fun. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll drive them wild! Everyone 
all over the world—with my race!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Because, because, wouldn't it be a total 
waste if a genius like me didn't compete 
on the world stage?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can't pull that off with my 
strength alone. I need someone right 
beside me to support me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So, will you keep sticking with me from 
now on? Right by my side, forever and 
ever!

Tokai Teio turns her straightforward gaze 
toward me. Her eyes are filled with 
conviction.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Nishishi! I knew you'd say that!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then let's play even more to celebrate! 
Come on, Trainer! Over here, over here!

Tokai Teio showed an innocent, carefree 
smile. I vowed in my heart to support her 
for as long as it takes.
